Create a new entry

Usage:
  gage insert <title> [flags]

Flags:
      --description string   optional description
  -e, --edit                 open a template in $EDITOR to fill in value/fields (and optionally title/description)
      --field stringArray    set a structured field as NAME=VALUE (repeatable; mutually exclusive with -e/--edit)
  -f, --force                allow inserting a duplicate title
  -m, --multiline            read the value as multiple lines from the terminal until EOF
  -u, --use string           vault to operate on (default: the current vault)
      --value-stdin          read the value verbatim from stdin (one trailing newline trimmed)
